content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: I hereby revoke all previous wills and codicils and declare this my last will and testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_PERSONAL_PROPERTY
content_blocks.text: My personal property, including but not limited to furniture, jewelry, and other tangible assets, shall be distributed as follows:...

content_blocks.label: clause_3._FUNERAL_ARRANGEMENTS
content_blocks.text: My funeral arrangements shall be made by Robert W. Hawthorne and shall be in accordance with my wishes as set forth in my burial instructions.
